children: Meta launched Muse on Sept 8: an AI assistant in the Meta app, WhatsApp and AI glasses. Muse handles tasks, integrates with major retailers and payments, and supported Meta’s ~30% September rally.
Meta Platforms (META) plans about $140 billion in 2024 capital spending to fund AI initiatives and Muse, signaling heavy investment in AI infrastructure and product development.
JPMorgan raised Meta Platforms (META) price target to $920 from $820 after launching Muse, citing Muse’s potential to become a widely used consumer AI app similar to ChatGPT.
Meta (META) launched Meta Enterprise Platform, bringing Muse AI agent and tools to enterprise clients. Chirantan Desai, former MongoDB CEO, will lead the initiative and report to Mark Zuckerberg.
META shifts toward business software to diversify beyond ads, leveraging Meta Business Agent on WhatsApp and Messenger; launch timing, pricing and enterprise customers remain undisclosed.
Meta Platforms (META) launched Muse for Small Business, targeting ~200 million SMBs with tools for customer chat, cash-flow and inventory management, website building, and direct customer messaging.
META: Muse app logged 2.8 million downloads in first 12 days in US and Canada. TD Cowen projects an AI-agent scenario tied to Muse could support up to $27 billion annual revenue.
Meta Platforms (META) flagged in House probe over secret NDA-linked deals tied to data-center projects; Meta is under scrutiny and has not commented.
META joined the White House AI pact; commitments include independent audits, stronger internal controls and board-level oversight for frontier AI development and deployment.
META classified Zuckerberg’s 2012–2013 stock option income as research wages, cutting its tax bill by about $355 million; the IRS is challenging that tax treatment.
